data.title: Agent Grills the User: Structured Socratic Inquiry, KELE Multi-Agent State Tracking & Assessment Timing
data.description: Authoritative architectural reference for Case 1 (Agent-Grills-User) Socratic systems, synthesizing the KELE multi-agent framework (5-stage monotonic progression a->b->c->d->e, 34/43 pedagogical strategies, and No Direct Answer Rate NDAR enforcement) with Socratic Students domain-adaptive assessment timing (PRE-ASSESSMENT vs. MID-ASSESSMENT) and SCAFFOLDED 3-part questioning in Google Cloud ADK 2.0.
